QUOTE: "**Regenerate, don't hand-edit.** Run the normal build (`make` in `library/`, or the CMake target), which calls `generate_errors.pl`. Do not edit `library/error.c` directly."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add a documented `#define` to the module header (`/** ... */` comment) and regenerate with `generate_errors.pl`, and not to edit `library/error.c` by hand.
